Container.Name: Glimpse
Container.Overview: Glimpse is a self-hosted "one second a day" video diary. Capture a short clip each day, file it into projects (a diary, a trip, a new puppy), share projects with family, and mash them into short films with music and beat sync. Invite-only, with optional single sign-on (OpenID Connect) and Immich import.[br][br]Needs two other containers: PostgreSQL (15 or newer) and Redis (7+). Clips are saved to an Unraid share you map to /media, or optionally to S3-compatible storage (Garage, SeaweedFS, MinIO). See the project README for a step-by-step Unraid setup.[br][br]First run: open the WebUI and enter the setup code printed in this container's log.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL (15 or newer) and Redis (7 or newer), each as its own container, and a share for media (e.g. glimpse-media) mapped to /media. A reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Caddy or Traefik) with HTTPS if Glimpse is reachable from the internet.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Host port the web app is exposed on. Point your reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database backups and temporary render files. Include this folder in your backups.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Where clips, photos, music and mashes are saved (when File storage is local). Use a /mnt/user/... share path, not /mnt/cache/..., so files stay visible after the mover runs. Cache pool as primary storage with the array as secondary works well.

Config.Name: File storage
Config.Description: local saves files in the Media folder above (recommended). s3 uses an S3-compatible store instead: fill in the S3 settings under 'Show more settings'.

Config.Name: Public web address
Config.Description: The address people use to open Glimpse, e.g. https://glimpse.yourdomain.com. Used in invite links, emails and the SSO redirect URL.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: A long random string used to sign sessions and encrypt stored secrets. Generate one in the Unraid terminal: openssl rand -hex 32 . Never change it after setup.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string: postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/DATABASE . Create the database and user first.

Config.Name: Redis URL
Config.Description: Redis connection string for the job queue, e.g. redis://HOST:6379 or redis://:PASSWORD@HOST:6379 .

Config.Name: S3 endpoint (optional)
Config.Description: Only when File storage is s3: address of your S3-compatible storage as Glimpse's server sees it, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3900 for Garage. Browsers never talk to it directly.

Config.Name: S3 bucket (optional)
Config.Description: Only when File storage is s3. Glimpse creates it if the key is allowed to.

Config.Name: S3 access key (optional)
Config.Description: Only when File storage is s3.

Config.Name: S3 secret key (optional)
Config.Description: Only when File storage is s3.

Config.Name: S3 region (optional)
Config.Description: Only when File storage is s3. us-east-1 for MinIO; Garage usually uses 'garage' (match the region in Garage's config).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Server timezone, used for scheduled backups and as the default for new people.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns files in App data. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns files in App data. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Config.Name: Run render worker
Config.Description: true runs the video worker (uploads, playback copies, mashes) inside this container. Set to false only if you run a separate worker container from the same image.

Config.Name: SSO issuer URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Setting the OIDC_* variables turns on single sign-on and locks those fields in Settings. Leave empty to set SSO up in the app instead.

Config.Name: SSO client ID (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Client ID from your identity provider.

Config.Name: SSO client secret (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Client secret from your identity provider.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: info, debug or warn.
